comment: The area packs maps.sustenaut.eu serves: one per municipality, at a path that sites use to find it, its county and its name (Rõuge vald, in Võru maakond: vorumaa/rouge). Each municipality one of the sites' places (places) is in gets one, made again when the places in it change; areas lists the ones built whether or not a place is in them. The overview covers all of Estonia.
